title: MolLean: A Process-Verifiable Language for Chemical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.20459v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chemical chain-of-thought can contain hallucinated structural and property claims. We thereby introduce MolLean, a process-verifiable language that grounds chemical reasoning in an explicit molecular state. A layered Lean-based kernel checks state transitions and assertions over molecular readouts, from primitive graph edits to compound transformations. Meanwhile, a typed witness protocol separates native structural checks from externally supplied measurements. We further introduce MolLean-MCP, a stateful tool interface that exposes these transitions, checks, and readouts during generation: the model receives feedback to decide its next action, and rejected actions leave the state unchanged. MolLean supports one-pass trace execution, whole-trace refinement, and interactive reasoning through MolLean-MCP. We evaluate these three modes with direct chain-of-thought on 8,800 matched examples across 12 tasks spanning molecular generation, edit

translated_title: MolLean：一种过程可验证的化学推理语言
translated_abstract: 化学思维链中可能包含幻觉生成的结构性与性质性论断。为此，我们提出了 MolLean，一种过程可验证的语言，将化学推理扎根于显式的分子状态之上。一个分层的、基于 Lean 的内核对分子读数上的状态转换与断言进行检查，涵盖从原始图编辑到化合物变换的各个层面。同时，一种带类型的见证协议将原生的结构检查与外部提供的测量值分离开来。我们进一步引入了 MolLean-MCP，一个有状态的工具接口，在生成过程中暴露这些转换、检查与读数：模型接收反馈以决定下一步动作，而被拒绝的动作不会改变状态。MolLean 支持单次轨迹执行、整轨迹细化以及通过 MolLean-MCP 进行的交互式推理。我们在跨越分子生成、编辑等 12 个任务的 8,800 个匹配样本上，将这三种模式与直接思维链方法进行了评估。
tldr: MolLean 提出了一种基于 Lean 的过程可验证化学推理语言，通过分层内核检查显式分子状态上的转换与断言、带类型的见证协议区分结构检查与外部测量，并借助有状态工具接口 MolLean-MCP 提供交互反馈，从而有效抑制化学思维链中的幻觉论断。
en_tdlr: MolLean introduces a Lean-based process-verifiable language that grounds chemical reasoning in an explicit molecular state, using kernel-checked state transitions, a typed witness protocol, and a stateful interactive tool interface (MolLean-MCP) to suppress hallucinated structural and property claims in chemical chain-of-thought.
